_comment: Phase 8 / 12-auto-remediation.md §5.4. SLIBurnRateFast (2% budget in 1h) is the alert that pages the on-call per the Google SRE workbook. Auto-remediation here only *amplifies* the page; it does not attempt corrective action (the burn may be from a deploy, code regression, infra, or external — wrong retry is worse than no retry). Severity=high, cooldown=3600 so we do not double-page during a sustained burn.
